title: Quenching Velvety Dutch Shungiku Toast
description: A rich, velvety, and bitter Dutch dish that's perfect for a midnight craving. This recipe features shungiku and is designed to be low glycemic.
instructions: Preheat your molcajete over low heat on the stovetop.
In a blender or food processor, puree the shungiku until smooth.
In a medium saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the eggs and cook, stirring constantly, until they begin to set.
Add the heavy cream and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the gruyere cheese until melted and smooth.
Add the pureed shungiku and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Toast the bread and place it in a separate bowl.
Pour the hot shungiku mixture over the toast and top with a sprinkle of pink salt.
Wash your molcajete thoroughly with soap and water after use.
